content.user_title: Review Home Waterproofing Plans and Common Mistakes
content.value_statement: Waterproofing decisions can be difficult when contractor quotes, drainage layouts, and inspection requirements are unclear. This skill organizes Chinese renovation references into practical questions, checklists, and troubleshooting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Consult 26 bundled Chinese references through a topic index covering waterproofing, renovation, costs, and contractor selection.
Explain reference guidance on waterproofing materials, coverage, preparation, and coordination with tiling.
Prepare inspection checklists covering water retention tests, drainage, pipe connections, and visible moisture.
Organize reported leak symptoms into preliminary checks and questions for plumbers or waterproofing contractors.
Review renovation quotes for unclear waterproofing areas, omitted preparation work, additional charges, and responsibility clauses.
Summarize moisture prevention and older-home refurbishment considerations from the bundled articles.
limitations: The skill cannot inspect buildings, measure moisture, locate hidden leaks, or certify completed work.
References conflict on kitchen and balcony waterproofing, wall coverage, and other construction recommendations.
Claims about current standards, prices, and legal responsibilities are not independently verified and may vary by location.
The bundle is Chinese text documentation, without executable tools, live updates, or a substitute for qualified professional assessment.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Bathroom Renovation Discussion
use_cases.description: Turn room dimensions, drainage details, and a proposed scope into questions about waterproofing coverage, preparation, testing, and responsibility.

use_cases.title: Organize a Leak Repair Handover
use_cases.description: Summarize reported symptoms, observations, and repair history into a checklist for the attending contractor.

use_cases.title: Review Waterproofing Quote Details
use_cases.description: Identify unclear quantities, exclusions, testing provisions, and warranty responsibilities before presenting a proposal to a client.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Main Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: I am planning my first bathroom renovation. Summarize the main waterproofing checks from the references. Separate general advice from points requiring professional confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner preparation before meeting a contractor

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Inspection Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: My bathroom is [area] with [drainage layout], and construction is at [stage]. Prepare an inspection checklist and list missing details to ask the contractor.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate preparation for a site visit

prompt_templates.title: Organize Leak Troubleshooting
prompt_templates.prompt: The leak appears at [location] after [conditions]. Previous repairs were [details]. Organize safe preliminary observations, possible causes, and questions for a qualified professional.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Quotes and Resolve Reference Conflicts
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these waterproofing quotes: [quotes]. Review scope, quantities, preparation, testing, exclusions, and responsibilities. Cite relevant references and identify conflicting recommendations requiring local professional verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before agreeing to a construction scope

output_examples.input: My bathroom quote only lists waterproofing area and price. What should I clarify?
output: Ask for separate floor and wall quantities, coverage heights, and the exact material system.
Confirm whether substrate repairs, corners, pipe penetrations, and protection before tiling are included.
Request written testing arrangements, inspection records, repair responsibilities, and warranty terms.
Have the proposed specification checked against local requirements and the material manufacturer instructions.

output_examples.input: The downstairs ceiling is wet even when our bathroom is unused. What information should I collect?
output: Record when moisture appears, recent water use, rainfall, and previous repairs.
If safe, close the relevant water supply and record whether the leak changes.
Photograph visible damage and contact the property manager or a qualified plumber.
Request professional checks of supply pipes, drainage, and waterproofing; the symptom alone does not establish the cause.

output_examples.input: Does a kitchen without a floor drain need waterproofing?
output: The bundled references disagree: some advise against waterproofing without a drain, while another states kitchen waterproofing is required.
Do not remove drainage or omit waterproofing based only on these articles.
Ask a qualified local professional to review applicable requirements, drainage, thresholds, and potential leak paths.

best_practices: Provide room dimensions, location, building age, drainage layout, construction stage, and the proposed scope before requesting advice.
Ask for reference citations and explicit conflicts, then verify specifications with local requirements and manufacturer instructions.
Use generated checklists to support professional inspections and retain written quotes, photographs, test records, and warranty terms.
anti_patterns: Treating every article recommendation as a universal building standard or proof of regulatory compliance.
Using a text response to authorize demolition, electrical work, gas alterations, or drainage removal without qualified assessment.
Accepting remote leak speculation as a confirmed diagnosis or treating illustrative prices as binding contractor quotes.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It organizes waterproofing and renovation reference material into explanations, contractor questions, inspection checklists, and preliminary troubleshooting notes.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The skill consists of instructions and reference documents, without a separate executable application.

faq.question: What language are the source materials?
faq.answer: The instructions and 26 reference articles are in Chinese. You can request another response language, but verify translated construction terminology.

faq.question: Can it confirm the cause of a leak?
faq.answer: No. It can organize symptoms and suggest questions, but hidden leaks require site assessment and appropriate professional testing.

faq.question: Are the construction standards and prices current?
faq.answer: The articles include dated claims, but the skill does not verify current regulations or local prices. Some recommendations contradict one another.

faq.question: Does the skill upload building details or run scripts?
faq.answer: The reviewed bundle contains no executable scripts or upload workflow. Information you provide remains subject to the selected AI service policies.
